_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE CMO demo -- a hypothetical $100M pool of 30-year, 6% fixed-rate mortgages, split into a real, standard three-tranche sequential-pay structure (A/B/C, most senior first), at 100% PSA. Also includes a real PSA-speed sensitivity table (100%/150%/200%/300% PSA) -- the same table every real CMO offering document publishes, showing how each tranche's Weighted Average Life shortens as prepayments speed up.
